# Porchlight

> Pre-inquiry foster-parent recruitment for Arizona licensing agencies: capture interest years before the application, keep "not yet" warm, and attribute every licensed home to its first touch.

## Project Overview

**Tech Stack:** Next.js **16.2** (App Router, TS, Tailwind v4) · Supabase (Postgres/RLS/Auth) · Resend · Vercel
**Status:** Live at **https://porchlightfostercare.org**. Milestones 0–5 complete and merged to `main`; migrations 0001–0010 applied. Five verification suites green.
**Purpose:** Private licensing agencies (the buyer) are judged on licensed homes; Porchlight instruments the four funnel stages before the inquiry that no other tool sees.

## Core Documentation

- `README.md` — Setup and the rules the code enforces
- `docs/PLAN.md` — Milestone plan (M0–M5)
- `docs/deploy-setup.md` — Production runbook: Vercel env, DNS, Supabase auth URLs
- `docs/az-data-sources.md` — DCS workbook inventory; read before touching the Arizona parser
- `docs/ai/memory.md` — Project history and current state
- `docs/ai/roadmap.md` — Forward-looking priorities
- `docs/ai/tasks.md` — Active work
- `docs/ai/decisions.md` — ADRs (read before changing schema or send paths)
- `docs/ai/architecture.md` — System design

## Key Files by Area

### Data & invariants
- `supabase/migrations/0001_schema.sql` — spine tables, immutability/append-only triggers, RLS, `public_capture()` / `set_contact_stage()` RPCs
- `supabase/migrations/0002_warmth.sql` — nurture templates (+ global default content), send_log, task queue
- `supabase/migrations/0003_erasure.sql` + `0004` — `delete_contact()` and the anon authz fix
- `supabase/migrations/0007_arizona.sql` — `az_*` public statistics (no write policy) + `agency_target` / `agency_county`
- `supabase/migrations/0008_journey.sql` — onboarding checklist; both journey FKs are `ON DELETE CASCADE` or erasure breaks
- `supabase/migrations/0009_team.sql` — invitations, `create_agency()` / `accept_invite()`

### App
- `src/app/page.tsx` — landing (signed out) vs dashboard (signed in); outside the route group
- `src/app/(app)/` — every authed page, under one layout that gates auth and renders `AppShell`
- `src/app/(app)/contacts/[id]/page.tsx` — contact detail, timeline, onboarding checklist (the demo centrepiece)
- `src/app/(app)/arizona/page.tsx` — state figures, county data, agency goals
- `src/app/c/[slug]/page.tsx` — public ten-second capture page (no DB read on load, by design)
- `src/app/join/[token]/page.tsx` — accept a team invitation
- `src/components/Landing.tsx` — storybook marketing page (house SVG scene)
- `src/components/ui/` — shared primitives; `Cited` requires a source, so no public figure renders unattributed
- `src/lib/arizona.ts` — reads `az_*`, attaches a citation to every figure
- `src/lib/demo/seed.ts` — fixed-seed demo generator (see ADR-010)

### Automation
- `src/lib/send.ts` — THE send gate (consent, idempotency, pause, demo refusal) — never bypass
- `src/app/api/cron/tick/route.ts` — daily heartbeat (wake-ups, nurture, cadence, cold flags)
- `src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts` — reply → pause + task
- `src/lib/admin.ts` — service-role client (server-only; not used anywhere under `src/app`)
- `scripts/az-stats-import.mjs` — the only writer of `az_stat`; run by hand twice a year

## Common Tasks

**Run locally:** `npm run dev` (preview config in `.claude/launch.json`); needs real values in `.env.local`.
**Verify a change:** `node scripts/smoke-test.mjs .env.local`, then `anon-audit.mjs` — mandatory after any migration adding a function or policy.
**Change a stage:** always via `set_contact_stage()` RPC — direct `contact.stage` updates are blocked by trigger.
**Add nurture content:** insert `nurture_template` rows (NULL agency_id = global default; agency rows override by step_no).
**Refresh Arizona figures:** download the two DCS workbooks into `az_docs/` by hand, then `node scripts/az-stats-import.mjs --apply`.

## Gotchas

- Every new function in the public schema is granted to `anon` by default — revoke by name. A policy with no `to` clause applies to `anon` too.
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` is inlined at build time; dashboard changes need a rebuild.
- Copy a pattern from the migration that last **fixed** it, not the one that created it.

## Environment Variables

- `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` / `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` — client + proxy (app degrades to landing-only without them)
- `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` — cron, webhooks, scripts (server only; no longer used by onboarding — ADR-012)
- `RESEND_API_KEY`, `EMAIL_FROM` — nurture email; `send.ts` skips cleanly when unset
- `CRON_SECRET`, `INBOUND_WEBHOOK_SECRET` — system endpoint auth; dev placeholders must not reach production
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` — base for QR codes and unsubscribe links; must name the domain Vercel actually serves
